Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> Can you tap a tapped card?
>
> Can you untap an untapped card?

You may apply a "tap it" effect to any card in play.

Doing so to a card that is already tapped won't power any effect that needed the
tapping (the "tap it to do something else" type cases), however.

Likewise for "untap it" effects.
